source: due2-native: eq over a set-valued operand (decisions/0025, #116)
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and passes odrl22-shape.ttl; the rejection is due2's. eq compares one value, as the Vocabulary defines it. "Holds the clearance" is written hasPart ex:Clearance (due2-profiles.md §4).

expected_rejection.why: ex:held is set-valued (due2:cardinality due2:set), and eq takes one left value. W1 rejects the policy in stage 2 (due2-profiles.md §4, decisions/0025).
